cases.name: Esther Bueno Dominguez Taboada
cases.about: Her Find-a-Grave entry says, "Esther worked at Sears as a credit clerk, but aspired to be an executive secretary. She was killed one day before she was to graduate from Westmont College. Esther had planned to get a better job and rent a nice home for herself and her two daughters, Angelica, 9, and 3-year-old Vanessa. Esther attended Goleta Union Elementary and Goleta Valley Junior High schools. After high school, she got jobs at places like K-Mart and Jack-in-the Box and worked her way up to manager. She loved to take her children to Goleta Beach."
cases.narrative: He allegedly stabbed her in the neck after she got into his vehicle in the parking lot of the business where she worked.
